title: Trustworthy Speech-Based Autism Screening under Class Imbalance with Uncertainty-Aware HuBERT Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2611.30390v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is critical for timely clinical intervention, although establishing reliable speech based screening systems remains problematic due to limited clinical data, class imbalance, and the need for reliable uncertainty estimation. We propose an uncertainty-aware ASD screening framework based on self-supervised HuBERT representations, combining Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) crossvalidation, balanced k-bagging, and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout. translated_title: 基于不确定性感知HuBERT集成的类不平衡条件下可信语音自闭症筛查
translated_abstract: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的早期筛查对于及时进行临床干预至关重要，然而由于临床数据有限、类别不平衡以及对可靠不确定性估计的需求，建立可靠的基于语音的筛查系统仍然面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于自监督HuBERT表示的不确定性感知ASD筛查框架，该框架结合了留一主体交叉验证、平衡k-bagging和蒙特卡洛（MC）Dropout。多个HuBERT模型在平衡子集上进行微调，其预测通过基于概率的集成平均进行组合，并在主体层面进行聚合。在儿童病理性语音数据库（CPSD）上的实验表现出强大性能，在话语层面达到了86.30%的平衡准确率和93.74%的ROC-AUC，在主体层面分别达到了95.04%和96.30%。此外，预测熵能够有效反映分类的可靠性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于不确定性感知HuBERT集成的语音自闭症筛查框架，通过留一主体交叉验证、平衡k-bagging和MC Dropout应对数据有限与类别不平衡问题，在CPSD数据集上主体层面达到95.04%平衡准确率和96.30% ROC-AUC。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware HuBERT ensemble framework for speech-based ASD screening that addresses limited data and class imbalance through LOSO cross-validation, balanced k-bagging, and MC Dropout, achieving 95.04% balanced accuracy and 96.30% ROC-AUC at the subject level on the CPSD dataset.
